GPTR-F-001-S130.title: Allowlist Schema & Contract Definition
GPTR-F-001-S130.description: Define a strict schema for GPTReader allowlist configuration including permitted collections, fields, operators, and query constraints, enforced via Pydantic or equivalent validation models.

GPTR-F-001-S131.title: Allowlist Configuration Loader
GPTR-F-001-S131.description: Implement a secure configuration loader that retrieves and initializes the allowlist rules at Azure Function startup, ensuring immutability during runtime and no dynamic override from request payloads.

GPTR-F-001-S132.title: Rejection Handling and Error Response Standardization
GPTR-F-001-S132.description: Implement standardized error handling for rejected queries, including clear denial reasons, safe messaging (no internal schema leakage), and consistent HTTP/status response structure.

GPTR-F-001-S133.title: Audit Logging for Scope Enforcement Decisions
GPTR-F-001-S133.description: Extend GPTReader audit logging to capture enforcement decisions, including allowed vs rejected queries, rule triggered, and metadata for traceability without storing sensitive payload data.
